tagline: The world's first and only quantum platform company delivering quantum-computing-as-a-service across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud
hero_kpi_rationale: IonQ reports a cumulative deficit of $1.194B as of December 31, 2025, reflecting an early-stage, highly capital-intensive phase characterized by significant investments in R&D and quantum infrastructure to achieve quantum advantage.

kpis.name: Cloud access to quantum computing
kpis.explanation: Access to quantum computing via the three major cloud providers (AWS Braket, Azure Quantum, Google Cloud).
kpis.description: IonQ distributes its quantum computers through three major cloud providers (AWS Braket, Microsoft Azure Quantum, Google Cloud Marketplace), amplifying its adoption potential in HPC and AI sectors. This cloud-native approach represents a key vector for future monetization.
kpis.signal: Strategic multi-cloud distribution amplifying adoption via QCaaS.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin is not mentioned in the extracted documents. As IonQ is in an early commercialization and loss-making phase, this metric is not disclosed.
kpis.signal: Data not available in the provided 10-K extracts.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by revenue, not available.
kpis.description: Operating margin is not provided in the 10-K. IonQ is in a phase of significant operating losses, with investment spending prioritized to reach technological milestones.
kpis.signal: Data not available in the provided 10-K extracts.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue, unspecified.
kpis.description: IonQ is making substantial investments in R&D to increase the number of physical and logical qubits and improve their performance, essential prerequisites for achieving quantum advantage. The percentage of revenue is not specified in the 10-K.
kpis.signal: R&D central to increasing qubit count and performance.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures (infrastructure)
kpis.explanation: Spending on fixed assets to develop quantum and satellite infrastructure.
kpis.description: Although not quantified in the provided extracts, capital expenditures are implicit in the development of highly technical quantum systems and satellite constellations for synthetic aperture radar imaging.
kpis.signal: High Capex likely for quantum systems and satellite constellation.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees not available.
kpis.description: Total headcount is not mentioned in the extracted 10-K. IonQ is in an early commercial growth phase and heavily reliant on key employees with specialized expertise in quantum computing.
kpis.signal: Headcount not disclosed, growth expected to support innovation.

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Net loss attributable to IonQ, Inc. for the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Net losses amounted to $510.4M in 2025, compared to $331.6M in 2024, reflecting increased investments in R&D, infrastructure, and commercialization.

kpis.name: Accumulated Deficit
kpis.explanation: Cumulative loss since the company's inception.
kpis.description: The accumulated deficit reached $1.1941B as of December 31, 2025, underscoring the company's early-stage, capital-intensive trajectory since inception. This path is consistent with a business model requiring massive investments prior to profitability.
kpis.signal: Accumulated deficit exceeding $1.1B as of December 31, 2025.

ai_positioning.summary: IONQ positions itself as a leader in quantum computing, developing advanced quantum technologies designed to transform information processing and solve complex problems that classical AI cannot efficiently handle. The company is making significant investments in R&D of quantum computing systems integrating machine learning algorithms and offers QCaaS access via major cloud providers.
